key.name: color-scheme
key.description: “system” follows the desktop, “light” and “dark” override it.

key.name: open-in-tabs
key.description: New and opened documents become tabs of the window they are opened from; otherwise each gets a window of its own.

key.name: content-width
key.summary: Widest the editor and the preview get, in pixels
key.description: The width new windows start with; a window can change its own.

key.name: wrap-text
key.summary: Wrap long lines in the editor

key.name: show-line-numbers
key.summary: Show line numbers in the editor

key.name: highlight-current-line
key.summary: Highlight the line with the cursor in the editor

key.name: shade-alternate-lines
key.summary: Shade every other line in the editor

key.name: tab-width
key.summary: Width of a tab in the editor, in spaces

key.name: zoom
key.summary: Text size, in points above or below 11

key.name: text-font
key.summary: Font family of the preview and of exported documents
key.description: Empty for the system document font.

key.summary: Font family of the editor and of code
